channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Owner of new sushi cafe dubs first three months a 'happy adventure'
item.description: Cafe owner Jung Hee Park, who runs Sprout Sushi with her husband, shares how the first three months of the business has been a "happy adventure".

item.title: Ramped up security measures for flats plagued by yobs
item.description: Council flats plagued by yobs are set for new security measures as City Hall give the green light.

item.title: Appeal for next of kin of man who died while on holiday in Norfolk
item.description: An appeal has been made for the relatives of a man who is believed to have been on holiday in Norfolk when he died to come forward.

item.title: Takeaway branch of popular seafood restaurant looks to extend opening hours
item.description: A takeaway branch of a coastal seafood restaurant is looking to extend its opening hours.

item.title: Heartfelt tributes to 'running buddy and lovely friend' who died from cancer
item.description: Heartfelt tributes have been paid to a Suffolk running club member who died after a brief battle with cancer.

item.title: Art gallery with seafront views reveals plans to offer alcohol
item.description: Cromer Artspace, which is on the Promenade, has applied for a new premises licence from North Norfolk District Council for the supply of alcohol.

item.title: 'A huge weight off our minds' - Villagers welcome flood defence overhaul after storms
item.description: People living in Hickling and Sutton in the Norfolk Broads have welcomed efforts to improve the villages' flood defences.

item.title: Historic hotel told to remove sea view terrace overlooking neighbour's window
item.description: Golden Lion Hotel in Hunstanton has been told to remove a new extension after it allowed guests to peer straight into a neighbour's flat.

item.title: Opinion: One door opens for WI after another closes following trangender ruling
item.description: The WIs' equality, diversity, and inclusion policy has been in place since the 1970s, offering a safe space where anyone presenting as a woman can be themselves, surrounded by other supportive women.

item.title: Opinion: Does being ashamed of Britain makes me unpatriotic?
item.description: Does being ashamed of Britain and how its people treat it make you unpatriotic?
